# tmsens R package: Sensitivity Analysis Using the Trimmed Mean Estimator

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/dea-hazewinkel/tmsens/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/dea-hazewinkel/tmsens/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![CRAN
status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/tmsens)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=tmsens)
[![RStudio_CRAN_mirror_downloads_badge](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/tmsens?color=blue)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=tmsens)

**tmsens** is on CRAN, you can install it in R with

``` r

install.packages("tmsens")
```

Or you can install the development version from GitHub with

``` r

# install.packages("remotes") # uncomment if remotes not installed
remotes::install_github("dea-hazewinkel/tmsens")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`summary(`*`<tm>`*`)`](https://dea-hazewinkel.github.io/tmsens/reference/summary.tm.md)
  : Summarizing Trimmed Means Linear Model Fits
- [`tm()`](https://dea-hazewinkel.github.io/tmsens/reference/tm.md) :
  Fitting Trimmed Mean Linear Models
- [`tm_bias()`](https://dea-hazewinkel.github.io/tmsens/reference/tm_bias.md)
  : Calculating Bias For Trimmed Mean Linear Models
- [`tmsens-package`](https://dea-hazewinkel.github.io/tmsens/reference/tmsens-package.md)
  [`tmsens`](https://dea-hazewinkel.github.io/tmsens/reference/tmsens-package.md)
  : tmsens: Sensitivity Analysis Using the Trimmed Mean Estimator
